class.name: SwiftViewHost
class.brief_description: Hosts a declarative Swift scene built by the Swift runtime (Swift-enabled builds only).
class.description: [SwiftViewHost] parents the root node produced by the Swift runtime's declarative UI (ABI entry [code]swiftgodot_scene_build[/code]) when it becomes ready, and re-renders it on demand through [method invalidate] (ABI entry [code]swiftgodot_scene_invalidate[/code]). Requires the [code]swiftgodot_runtime[/code] library to be present.

method.name: invalidate
method.description: Asks the Swift runtime to re-render the hosted scene (scoped invalidation through the attribute graph).
